texts.host_toml:
# 群の宣言（架空の口座と project）
[defaults]
model = "opus"

[[account]]
label = "acct-1"
plan = "max"

[[account]]
label = "acct-2"  # 注釈

[[account]]
label = "acct-3"

[[account]]
label = "acct-4"

[[account-group]]
name = "main"
anchors = ["/work/proj-a", "/work/proj-c"]
accounts = ["acct-1", "acct-2", "acct-4"]

[[account-group]]
name = "aux"
anchors = [
  "/work/proj-b",  # 注釈
]
accounts = ["acct-2", "acct-3"]

[seat]
name = "not-a-group"
texts.usage:
usage: account=acct-1 five_hour=83% resets=2026-09-27T15:00:00Z seven_day=40% resets=2026-10-01T00:00:00Z model=opus:12% resets=none
usage: account=acct-2 five_hour=5% resets=none seven_day=300% resets=none model=sonnet:0% resets=none
usage: account=acct-3 unmeasured reason=no-token
texts.doctor:
doctor: state dir ok
group=main accounts=acct-1,acct-2,acct-4 anchors=2 seat-accounts=acct-1 current=acct-1 next=acct-2 refused=-
group=aux accounts=acct-2,acct-3 anchors=1 seat-accounts=acct-1 current=acct-2 next=none refused=acct-3:retired
account=acct-1 dir=/work/accounts/acct-1 retired=no
account=acct-2 dir=/work/accounts/acct-2 retired=no
account=acct-3 dir=/work/accounts/acct-3 retired=yes
account=acct-4 dir=/work/accounts/acct-4 retired=no
seat: role=orchestrator anchor=/work/proj-a target=proj-a:0.1 account=acct-1 model=opus heartbeat=on tick=ok

seat_doctors./work/proj-a:
doctor: state dir ok
seat: role=pipeline anchor=/work/proj-a target=proj-a:1.1 account=acct-2 model=opus heartbeat=on tick=ok
seat: role=orchestrator anchor=/work/proj-z target=proj-z:0.1 account=acct-4 model=opus heartbeat=on tick=ok
seat: role=orchestrator anchor=/work/proj-a target=proj-a:0.1 account=acct-1 model=opus heartbeat=on tick=ok
seat_doctors./work/proj-b:
doctor: state dir ok
seat: role=orchestrator anchor=/work/proj-b/ target=proj-b:0.1 account=acct-1 model=sonnet heartbeat=off tick=ok
